name: The Death Trophy, Badlands and Tanaris worldforge pickups keep their corrected positions
contract: #10507, #10520 and #10527 each shipped a *_revert.sql beside the fix in pending_db_world. The updater applies pending files in name order, so each revert ran right after its fix and restored the old spot. Each spawn now loads at the fix's position: the old positions are 0.35 yd (Death Trophy guid 6941373), 11.9 yd (Buried Chest guid 6940271) and 2.54 yd (Deadman Gauntlets guid 6941616) away from it.
